data.name: Energy Blast
data.description: The ranged attack gained from the ranged attack customization is now treated as a ranged touch attack and instead deals %1d6 points of damage of your active energy type, but requires a standard action to use and cannot be used as part of a full attack.  This effect can be turned on or off as a move action.|RangedAttackDice
